This script provides details on miRNA differential expression across time point in Mcap development.  

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# The following setting is important, do not omit.
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) #Set Strings to character
```

Load packages 
```{r}
#if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#    install.packages("BiocManager")

#BiocManager::install("DESeq2")

#library(genefilter)
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(gplots)
library(wesanderson)
library(cowplot)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
```

Load counts data
```{r}
counts <- read.delim("../output/Molecular/miRNA/miRNAs_expressed_all_samples_1794889168.csv", header = T)
counts <- as.data.frame(counts)
```

Select normalized counts for analysis. 
```{r}
norm_counts <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(X.miRNA, ends_with(".norm.")) %>%
  rename_with(~ .x %>%
      str_remove("\\.norm\\.") %>%     
      str_replace("^s0?", "M"), ends_with(".norm."))

# Save as csv 
write.csv(norm_counts, "../output/Molecular/miRNA/miRNAs_expressed_normalized.csv")
```

Make miRNA col the row names
```{r}
rownames(norm_counts) <- make.names(norm_counts[,1], unique = TRUE)
norm_counts <- norm_counts[,-1]
```

Read in metadata 
```{r}
meta <- read.csv("../data/sample_metadata/tube_meta_mcap.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(TubeID, Date, hpf, Metric, EmbryosPerTube) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Metric == "Molecular")

# Filter for sequenced samples
meta_filt <- meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(TubeID %in% colnames(norm_counts))
```

Reorder columns in filtered counts matrix so that it matches the metadata
```{r}
norm_counts <- norm_counts[, meta_filt$TubeID]

# Sanity check! 
meta_filt$TubeID %in% colnames(norm_counts) #are all of the sample names (rows) in the metadata df in the gene count matrix? Should be TRUE. 
all(rownames(meta_filt$TubeID) == colnames(norm_counts)) #are they the same in the same order? Should be TRUE
```

Set levels of factors 
```{r}
meta_filt$hpf <- factor(meta_filt$hpf, levels = c("1 hpf", "4 hpf", "9 hpf", "14 hpf", "22 hpf", "28 hpf", "48 hpf", "72 hpf"))
```

Set filtered counts to integer 
```{r}
norm_counts[] = lapply(norm_counts, as.integer)
str(norm_counts)
```

Construct DESeq data set looking at gene expression across time points. 
```{r}
gdds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = norm_counts, colData = meta_filt, design = ~hpf)
```

Visualize expression
```{r}
# Transpose the data for PCA
counts_t <- t(norm_counts)

# Merge with metadata
pca_data <- merge(meta_filt, counts_t, by.x = "TubeID", by.y = "row.names")

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(pca_data[,-(1:5)], scale. = TRUE)

# Create the plot
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
pca_df$hpf <- pca_data$hpf

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = hpf)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label = rownames(pca_df)), size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA of miRNA Counts",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2,1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2,2] * 100, 1), "%)")) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

Make a heatmap
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1. Order metadata by developmental stage (hpf)
meta_sorted <- meta_filt %>%
  rownames_to_column("TubeID") %>%
  arrange(hpf) %>%
  #column_to_column if needed...
  column_to_rownames("TubeID")

# 2. Reorder matrix columns to match the sorted metadata
norm_counts_sorted <- norm_counts[, rownames(meta_sorted)]

# 3. Log2-transform normalized counts (RPM)
log2_counts <- log2(norm_counts_sorted + 1)

# 4. Filter for top variable miRNAs (e.g., top 50 by variance across timepoints)
top_var_mirnas <- head(order(rowVars(as.matrix(log2_counts)), decreasing = TRUE), 200)
log2_counts_top <- log2_counts[top_var_mirnas, ]

# 5. Build annotation data frame for heatmap columns
annotation_col <- meta_sorted %>%
  select(hpf)

# 6. Set custom colors for hpf stages
hpf_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Spectral"))(length(levels(meta_sorted$hpf)))
names(hpf_colors) <- levels(meta_sorted$hpf)
ann_colors <- list(hpf = hpf_colors)

# 7. Plot Heatmap (cluster_cols = FALSE keeps samples strictly ordered by hpf)
pheatmap(
  log2_counts_top,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  show_rownames = FALSE,               # Turn off long scaffold row labels
  show_colnames = FALSE,               # Turn off squished column labels (hpf bar conveys the stage)
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  treeheight_row = 30,                 # Shrink dendrogram width to make heatmap wider
  main = "M. capitata Embryonic miRNA Expression (Ordered by hpf)"
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Transpose matrix (prcomp expects samples as rows and miRNAs as columns)
# Filter out zero-variance miRNAs first to prevent scaling errors
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(log2(norm_counts + 1))
non_zero_var <- rowVars(counts_matrix) > 0
pca_input <- t(counts_matrix[non_zero_var, ])

# 2. Compute PCA
pca_res <- prcomp(pca_input, scale. = TRUE)

# 3. Calculate percentage of variance explained
var_explained <- round(100 * (pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)), 1)

# 4. Combine PC scores with metadata
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("TubeID") %>%
  left_join(meta_filt %>% rownames_to_column("TubeID"), by = "TubeID")

# 5. Plot PCA
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = hpf, label = TubeID)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.85) +
  #scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Developmental Stage") + # Or use discrete palette matching heatmap
  labs(
    title = "PCA of M. capitata miRNA Profiles Across Embryogenesis",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "% Variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "% Variance)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

Plotting avg heatmap
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(matrixStats)

# 1. Log2 transform the full aligned count matrix
log2_counts <- log2(norm_counts_aligned + 1)

# 2. Extract sample-to-hpf mapping (matching column names order)
hpf_factor <- meta_filt[colnames(log2_counts), "hpf"]

# 3. Calculate row-wise means for each hpf level
log2_counts_mean <- sapply(levels(hpf_factor), function(stage) {
  samples <- colnames(log2_counts)[hpf_factor == stage]
  if (length(samples) == 1) {
    return(log2_counts[, samples])
  } else {
    return(rowMeans(log2_counts[, samples, drop = FALSE]))
  }
})

# Convert back to matrix format
log2_counts_mean <- as.matrix(log2_counts_mean)

# Verify dimensions (should be: N miRNAs x 8 hpf timepoints)
head(log2_counts_mean)

# 1. Select top variable miRNAs across timepoints (e.g., top 50)
top_var_idx <- head(order(rowVars(log2_counts_mean), decreasing = TRUE), 288)
mean_matrix_top <- log2_counts_mean[top_var_idx, ]

# 2. Build timepoint annotation header
time_annotation <- data.frame(
  hpf = factor(colnames(log2_counts_mean), levels = levels(hpf_factor)),
  row.names = colnames(log2_counts_mean)
)

# 3. Generate Heatmap
pheatmap(
  mean_matrix_top,
  scale = "row",             # Z-score scaling across timepoints to highlight shift
  cluster_cols = FALSE,      # Keep strict 1 hpf -> 72 hpf chronological order
  cluster_rows = TRUE,       # Cluster miRNAs with synchronized expression profiles
  annotation_col = time_annotation,
  show_rownames = FALSE,     # Set to TRUE if using clean mcap-mir-novel IDs
  show_colnames = TRUE,      # Will cleanly show 1 hpf, 4 hpf, 9 hpf, etc.
  angle_col = "0",           # Keep timepoint text horizontal
  main = "Mean M. capitata miRNA Expression Across Embryogenesis"
)
```

Cluster
```{r}
ph <- pheatmap(
  mean_matrix_top, # Your top 200 matrix
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  annotation_col = time_annotation,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  main = "Mean M. capitata miRNA Expression Across Embryogenesis"
)

# 2. Cut the row dendrogram into 4 developmental clusters
row_clusters <- cutree(ph$tree_row, k = 4)

# 3. Create a data frame linking miRNA IDs to their temporal cluster
mirna_clusters <- data.frame(
  miRNA = names(row_clusters),
  Cluster = paste0("Cluster_", row_clusters)
)

# 4. Check cluster counts
table(mirna_clusters$Cluster)
```












Run test using the LRT to look for effect of lifestage as a whole across our experiment. There is only one main effect, so the reduced model is just the intercept.    
```{r, message = FALSE}
DEG <- DESeq(gdds, test="LRT", reduced=~1)
resultsNames(DEG)
```

Save all DE results, regardless of significance 
```{r}
DEG_results_all<-as.data.frame(results(DEG))
DEG_results_all$gene <- rownames(DEG_results_all)
rownames(DEG_results_all) <- NULL
dim(DEG_results_all)

# Save as csv 
write.csv(DEG_results_all, "../output/Molecular/miRNA/miRNA_DE_results_all.csv")
```

Filter by adjusted p value <0.05, this is generated by the LRT test statistic. 
```{r}
DEG_results <- subset(DEG_results_all, padj<0.05)
dim(DEG_results)

# Save as csv 
write.csv(DEG_results, "../output/Molecular/miRNA/miRNA_DE_results.csv")
```

Conduct VST transformation for visualization.  
```{r}
DEG_results_vst <- gdds[unique(DEG_results$gene)]
dim(DEG_results_vst)

DEG_results_vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(DEG_results_vst) 
```

Generate a PCA     
```{r}
# make pca plot 
pcaData_DEG <- plotPCA(DEG_results_vst, intgroup = c("hpf"), returnData = TRUE)

percentVar_DEG <- round(100 * attr(pcaData_DEG, "percentVar"))
ggplot(pcaData_DEG, aes(PC1, PC2, color = hpf, label = name)) + 
  #geom_point(size = 3) + 
  #geom_jitter(size = 4, width = 1.5, height = 1.5, stroke = 1) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = hpf), size = 5, width = 1.5, height = 1.5, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
  #geom_text(vjust = 1.5, hjust = 1.5) + # This adds the labels
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_DEG[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_DEG[2], "% variance")) +
  scale_color_discrete() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
        #axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = -1.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5))
```
